t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep an eye on which gnomes go to which forests, as one forest earns more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are shown in pairs, one gnome from each pair takes you to the yellow basket and the other takes you to the red basket (to collect the mushrooms in). Try and work out which colours take you to each basket, and then stick to one colour basket when it is showing more mushrooms. The baskets take it in turns having more mushrooms.
